summary:
Iteration 42 — Referring-doctor notify (opt-in per-stream), multi-range comparison in doctor drill-down, and ReferringDoctorPicker in Book-Appointment modal. All 3 backend pytest cases + all 3 frontend flows PASS end-to-end against the preview deployment.

BACKEND (3/3 passed via /app/backend/tests/test_iter42_refdoc_notify.py):
  ✅ POST /api/referring-doctors with notify_on_diag=true/notify_on_ha=false → echoed correctly; PUT flips both flags → verified; GET list echoes new fields; DELETE cleans up.
  ✅ Session mark-printed → referral_notifications collection receives a fresh row with stream='diagnostics' (fire-and-forget audit log confirmed via Mongo polling for 5s). Because MSG91 is unconfigured in preview, entry.status='queued_no_provider' and reason='msg91_not_configured' — EXPECTED and matches the spec.
  ✅ POST /api/appointments accepts referring_doctor_id in the payload without validation errors (visit_type=referral).

FRONTEND:
  ✅ TASK 3.b (Settings UI):  /settings/referral-doctors → Add Referral Doctor modal renders 'WhatsApp thank-you (optional)' section with 2 separate checkboxes ref-doc-notify-diag + ref-doc-notify-ha. Filled name='Dr. Notify E2E' + phone='9998887777', ticked both, saved. New row in ref-doc-table shows BOTH 'DIAG' + 'HA' badges in the Notify cell. Edit → uncheck HA → save → row shows ONLY 'DIAG'. Deleted; row gone.
  ✅ TASK 2 (Multi-Range Comparison): /referrals → clicked first ref-doc-drilldown-* → doctor-drilldown-modal opens and drilldown-compare-ribbon renders 'VS PREVIOUS WINDOW · Prev: 2026-06-06 → 2026-06-30' with 4 previous-window figures (Patients 0 / Diag ₹0 / HA ₹0 / Payout ₹0). All 4 delta chips present with '= no change vs prev' text (correct behavior for both-zero windows).
  ✅ TASK 1 (Picker in Book Appointment): /calendar → New Appointment → Patient tile → BookAppointmentModal → clicked bk-visit-referral → bk-referred-by-picker rendered (0 legacy 'Referred by (ENT...)' inputs). Typing 'Prakash' produced autocomplete showing 'Dr. Prakash Iyer — ENT · Bangalore Hospital · +91-9900000001' AND the auto-add suggestion '+ Add new doctor: Prakash'. Confirms the picker is wired into the appointment-booking flow.

REGRESSION: /settings/referral-doctors CRUD (add/edit/delete + notify column) works end-to-end without console errors. Referral Corner /referrals loads without errors and drill-down works.
critical_code_review_comments: services/ref_docs_notify.py: `entry` dict is mutated across every early-return branch. Not a bug (each branch writes then returns) but a future refactor risk if someone adds a code path that reuses `entry` after insert. Consider making each branch build its own entry copy.

services/ref_docs_notify.py schedule_notify(): catches only RuntimeError. If asyncio.create_task raises anything else (e.g., cancelled loop, resource exhaustion), it will bubble into the sync caller (report_handover.py wraps it in a try/except so it's fine, but ha_sales.py should be checked for the same). Recommend broadening the except in schedule_notify to `except Exception` and logging.

DoctorDrillDownModal.jsx multi-range compare: when both windows are 0, all 4 delta chips show '= no change vs prev' — clear and correct. Consider showing the actual delta value (e.g., '▲ 5') even when the prior value is 0 (currently might just show 'new' or something similar for those edge cases). Not tested with non-zero data in this preview clinic (no diagnostics activity in the prior window).

BookAppointmentModal.js: When picker auto-creates a new doctor via '+ Add new doctor:', ensure the newly-minted doctor_id is captured before the appointment POST. The E2E didn't exercise this branch (existing doctor was picked); recommend a targeted regression test for auto-add-then-save so the referring_doctor_id makes it into the POST /api/appointments payload cleanly.

The tile-highlighting emerald color for ref-doc-notify-diag/ha is applied on the checkbox INPUT (`text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500`) rather than the surrounding tile wrapper — visually the checkbox turns emerald but the tile background stays white. If the spec intended a tile-wide emerald fill on tick, the wrapping <label> needs a state-driven bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-500 class.
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates & deletes ephemeral Dr. Notify QA/Trig doctors, a TEST_NotifyPatient, and a hearing test session (session left behind because /sessions has no DELETE — non-blocking, preview data only). Frontend test creates and deletes 'Dr. Notify E2E'. All cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: /login → 2 unlabeled inputs (nth(0)=email, nth(1)=password) → button[type=submit]. After login the app lands on /patients (not /dashboard); use `page.wait_for_selector('text=Sign out')` to detect logged-in state reliably. To open Book Appointment modal: nav to /calendar (or click sidebar 'Calendar'), click the '+ NEW APPOINTMENT' button in StaffRail → IntentChooser opens → click 'Patient' tile → BookAppointmentModal. The Visit-type segmented control has data-testids bk-visit-{walkin|referral|consultation}. The ReferringDoctorPicker inside the modal has data-testid=bk-referred-by-picker and renders two <button> children when suggestions match: the first is the existing-doctor row, the last is '+ Add new doctor: <query>'. For notification audit polling: after POST /api/sessions/{id}/mark-printed, allow ~500ms–3s before querying referral_notifications — the write is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task. In preview, status will be 'queued_no_provider' with reason 'msg91_not_configured' (MSG91 not configured for the tenant) — this is the expected happy-path signal that the wire-up fired.
